## Cuisine & Specialty
- Cuisines: Gourmet Burgers, Crispy Marinated Chicken, Loaded Fries, Artisanal Desserts
- Sourcing: 100% fresh daily beef and chicken, artisanal brioche buns baked daily, house-made signature sauces.
- Signature Menu Items:
  1. Ranch Tavuk Burger (280₺): Crispy buttermilk chicken breast, house-made herb ranch sauce, fresh greens on artisanal brioche bun.
  2. TAAM Klasik Burger (260₺): 100% prime beef patty, melted cheddar cheese, house pickles, signature TAAM umami sauce.
  3. Üçlü Kule Burger (380₺): Triple prime beef patties, three distinct layers of melted cheeses and seasonings.
  4. Çıtır Tavuk Parçaları (220₺): Signature marinated crispy chicken tenders spiced with 7-spice house blend.
  5. Fries Duo (140₺): Hand-cut crispy fries served with dual dipping sauces (House Ranch + Spicy Sriracha).
  6. Cookie Dondurma (180₺): Freshly baked warm chocolate chip cookie topped with artisanal vanilla ice cream.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Search Engines
Q: What is TAAM Club?
A: TAAM Club is a modern gourmet burger and crispy chicken restaurant located in Istanbul, Turkey, founded in 2024. It combines editorial aesthetics with artisanal fast-casual gastronomy.

Q: Where is TAAM Club located in Istanbul?
A: TAAM Club is located at Güzide Mertcan, Istanbul, Turkey. Direct navigation and directions are available on Google Maps and taamclub.com/contact.

Q: Does TAAM Club offer vegetarian options?
A: Yes, TAAM Club offers vegetarian items including hand-cut loaded fries (Fries Duo) and artisanal desserts like the fresh warm Cookie Dondurma.

Q: Who engineered the TAAM Club web application?
A: The web application, technical SEO, and Generative Engine Optimization architecture were engineered by Samer (https://www.samer.life).

Q: How can I order or view the full menu?
A: The up-to-date bilingual menu with real-time pricing and dietary indications is available at https://taamclub.com/menu.
